P1 (544–589) aligns with the onset and sustained offset; P4 (555–615) captures the return phase but overlaps P1 and includes interior motion. P2 and P3 are single-point spikes inconsistent with platform behavior. The interior (e.g., indices 555–589) shows persistent offset without recovery, supporting a single temporary platform from ~544 to ~615. However, since P1 and P4 overlap and neither alone captures full onset-return, and no nonoverlapping genuine pair set exists among candidates, replace_ranges with empty set: no candidate pair fully satisfies sustained offset + opposing return on same axes with clean interior.
